description: Create remaining Expo Mobile starters (IDs 26-36): expo-admob-utility, expo-ai-companion, expo-social-community, expo-marketplace-app, expo-booking-app, expo-habit-fitness-app, expo-content-reader, expo-local-first-app, expo-delivery-tracker, expo-event-app, expo-ecommerce-app. Follow expo-subscription-app as reference pattern.
steps: Create expo-admob-utility (ID 26): Expo Router + anonymous/local auth + SQLite + AdMob + optional RevenueCat + Firebase Analytics. Structure: src/ (domain/, adapters/, storage/, components/), app/ (Expo Router tabs), __tests__/. Fake adapters for AdMob and analytics. Jest config.
Create expo-ai-companion (ID 27): Expo Router + Supabase Auth + Supabase/SQLite + RevenueCat + AI API. Domain: Conversation, Message, UserProfile. Fake adapters for AI and purchases.

Create expo-social-community (ID 28): Expo Router + Clerk + Convex/SQLite + Stream Chat + push notifications. Domain: Post, Profile, Comment, Chat. Fake adapters for chat (stream-fake.ts) and realtime (convex-fake.ts).
Create expo-marketplace-app (ID 29): Expo Router + Supabase Auth + Supabase/SQLite + Stripe Connect + Algolia + Google Maps. Domain: Listing, Order, Seller, Review. Fake adapters for search and maps.
Create expo-booking-app (ID 30): Expo Router + Supabase Auth + Supabase/SQLite + Stripe + Calendar + Google Maps + push notifications. Domain: Booking, TimeSlot, Venue, Review.

Create expo-habit-fitness-app (ID 31): Expo Router + Firebase Auth + Firebase Firestore/SQLite + RevenueCat + Android Health Connect + push notifications. Domain: Habit, Workout, HealthMetric, Streak.
Create expo-content-reader (ID 32): Expo Router + optional local auth + Sanity/SQLite + AdMob + Firebase Messaging. Domain: Article, Category, Bookmark, ReadingProgress. Fake for Sanity CMS.
Create expo-local-first-app (ID 33): Expo Router + Supabase Auth + SQLite + Supabase + Expo background task. Domain: Note, SyncQueue, Conflict. Focus on offline-first with sync queue.

Create expo-delivery-tracker (ID 34): Expo Router + Firebase Auth + Firebase Firestore/SQLite + Google Maps + background location + push notifications. Domain: Delivery, Route, LocationUpdate, Driver.
Create expo-event-app (ID 35): Expo Router + Supabase Auth + Supabase/SQLite + Stripe + QR scanning + push notifications. Domain: Event, Ticket, Attendee, CheckIn.

Create expo-ecommerce-app (ID 36): Expo Router + Shopify customer token + Shopify Storefront API/SQLite + Shopify native checkout + push notifications. Domain: Product, Cart, Order, Customer. Fake for Shopify API.

Each starter MUST have: starter.json, package.json with exact-pinned expo deps, pnpm-lock.yaml, app.config.ts with unique Android package identifier, README.md, .env.example, __tests__/ with jest tests, jest.config.js, .npmrc, babel.config.js, eas.json.
acceptance_criteria: All 11 Expo Mobile starter folders exist with correct structure
Each has a valid starter.json matching catalog/starters.json entry
Each has pnpm-lock.yaml generated by pnpm install
Each has unique Android package identifier in app.config.ts
Each has jest tests that pass with fake adapters
pnpm catalog:validate passes for these starters
verification: Run pnpm install in each new starter to confirm lockfile validity
Run pnpm test in each starter to confirm jest tests pass
